description: This file defines an abstract base class 'DestinationBase' for migrate destination plugins in Drupal, handling migration import operations, rollback support, and plugin configuration.

classes.name: DestinationBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for migration destination plugins, including rollback support and configuration handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the destination plugin with configuration, plugin ID, definition, and migration instance.

methods.name: checkRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the plugin meets the requirements, throws exception if not.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Default implementation for rollback operation, does nothing.

methods.name: setRollbackAction
methods.description: Sets the rollback action for an entity being updated.

methods.name: getDestinationModule
methods.description: Retrieves the destination module name from configuration, plugin definition, or migration provider.
